title: Pantheon Postmortem
description: Canonical postmortem record. Attached to an IncidentCase via the formal lineage edge postmortem.incident_case (incident_id → IncidentCase). Propagates binding and lineage evidence for direct querying. Write authority: Incident domain only.

postmortem_id.description: Unique identifier for this postmortem (UUID recommended).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the postmortem.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the postmortem document.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the postmortem was created (UTC ISO-8601).

published_at.description: Timestamp when the postmortem was published. Required when status is published.

incident_id.description: IncidentCase reference — formal lineage edge postmortem.incident_case.

binding_id.description: RuntimeBinding reference propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

deployment_stage.description: Deployment stage at time of incident (propagated from IncidentCase).

deployment_plan_id.description: DeploymentPlan reference propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

capital_pool_id.description: CapitalPool reference propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

persona_capital_binding_id.description: PersonaCapitalBinding reference propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

artifact_id.description: Artifact reference propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

artifact_version.description: Artifact version propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

runtime_id.description: Runtime identifier propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier propagated from the parent IncidentCase.

root_cause.description: Root cause analysis of the incident.

contributing_factors.description: List of factors that contributed to the incident.

actor.description: Who or what performed the action.

timeline.description: Ordered timeline of events during the incident.

action_items.description: Follow-up action items identified during postmortem analysis.

author_ids.description: IDs of the authors who contributed to this postmortem.

linked_evolution_decision_id.description: EvolutionDecision reference set by EVO-003 (evolution_decision.postmortem edge). Null until an EvolutionDecision links back to this postmortem.
